chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning the salat of the two Eids.
He said: He joins the recitation to the recitation. Then he said: He begins with the takbir in the first rakʿah, then he recites and bows with the seventh.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the saying of Allahu Akbar within the prayer
key_terms.السَّابِعَةِ: the seventh takbir counted before bowing
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the ritual prayer of the two Eids

ai.seo_question: How is the takbir performed in the first rakʿah of salat al-ʿidayn?
ai.summary: This hadith describes part of the manner of takbir in the salat of the two Eids. It indicates that in the first rakʿah one begins with the takbir, then recites, and performs rukuʿ with the seventh takbir.
